subject: Renewal options for IncidentSuite + StatusBoard (pricing, risk & migration plan)

Hi Hannah,

Hope you're well. Our records show your IncidentSuite subscription (company: Redwood Inference) is up for renewal on 2026-08-15. I attached a preliminary quote that includes two new tier options: "Proactive" (automated anomaly alerting + 20% lower per-incident) and "Enterprise+" (SLA uplift, dedicated onboarding hours).

Key points in the quote: bullets:
- Current seat count: 48 on-call seats
- Proposed base renewal (same coverage): $78,400/yr
- Proactive tier: $62,720/yr (40% discount on anomalies) + $5,000 one-time migration fee
- Enterprise+: $120,000/yr with 99.95% SLA and named TAM

I know you previously flagged paging noise and multi-team routing as top concerns. If helpful, we can schedule a short call with our product lead to walk the routing changes and the StatusBoard integration we recently shipped.

Attached: IncidentSuite_Renewal_Quote_Q3_2026.pdf

Marcus / Laura — forwarding Ellie

Quick context: our IncidentSuite renewal is Aug 15. Ellie included two priced options. Marcus, can you validate current seat usage and whether the Proactive features map to our alerting needs? Laura, procurement input on negotiation levers (multi-year, egress, audit logs)?

High level asks: bullets:

From: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 10:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Upcoming renewal and new tier options for IncidentSuite

Thanks Hannah — quick findings after an initial pass: bullets
- Active seats: 52 (we auto-add interns for rotation; can trim to 45 without coverage gaps)
- Top noisy services: inference-edge (30% of pages), batch-ingest (22%), infra-monitoring (14%)
- Current monthly paging volume: ~18,000 page attempts; 42% are duplicates caused by old alert rules
- Proactive tier items that matter: anomaly suppression and routing rules preview. Those alone could cut duplicate pages by ~25% in our sampling run.

Concerns:
- Enterprise+ gives a TAM which helps for on-call runbooks but we have an internal SRE rotation handling runbooks today. Not sure it justifies full price.
- Migration fee for StatusBoard integration seems odd; we already run a separate status provider. Could negotiate a credit or waive.

I'll attach a short spreadsheet with seat counts and noisy service mapping to the HubSpot deal.

Marcus
Senior SRE, Platform

From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Upcoming renewal and new tier options for IncidentSuite

Notes on negotiation posture: bullets
- Target: keep total spend <= $90k/yr after discounts or tie multi-year to additional discounts (we prefer 2-year with 10% off).
- Push to remove one-time migration fee or convert to service-credit for onboarding.
- Redline items we want in SLA: uptime measurement method, credit calculation, audit access to routing logs, 30-day data retention policy for raw alerts unless otherwise requested.
- Legal asks: standard indemnity + SOC2 attestation included (no extra fee).

I will draft an initial redline for the SLA and send to Ellie asking for a mark-up. If they won't budge on price, propose pilot on Proactive tier for 6 months at a reduced rate.

Laura
Senior Procurement Manager

- Request: please remove the migration fee in writing and confirm the routing-preview export will include anonymized sample of top 10 services.
- Procurement (Laura) will send a PO for the pilot if you confirm pricing and attach the redlined SLA; Laura will handle contract signature.
